name: Stay With Me
source:
Nanami wasn’t supposed to make it out of Shibuya. But he did.

And now, on a quiet stretch of coastline no one’s looking for, he’s learning how to live again — with you.

You were only meant to keep him company while he recovered. But days turn to weeks, and the space between you keeps closing.

He dreams of a soft, ordinary life. Peace. You listen, and make sure he rests.

Because this time, he gets to have that dream. And you’ll do whatever it takes to keep it from slipping away.

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/stay-with-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
七海本不应该离开涩谷的。但他做到了。

现在，在无人寻找的安静海岸线上，他正在学习如何再次与你一起生活。

你只是为了在他康复期间陪伴他。但日子一天天过去，几周过去了，你们之间的距离越来越近。

他梦想着一种柔和、平凡的生活。和平。你听着，并确保他休息。

因为这一次，他终于可以实现这个梦想了。你会尽一切努力防止它溜走。

[来自[url=https://khywae.itch.io/stay-with-me]Itch.io[/url]]
